issue.title: Defer full master catalogue out of progressive login Tier 1
issue.body:
## Context

Follow-up from [#670](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/670).

Progressive login Tier 1 still awaits full `syncMasterData` because project/assignment inserts FK to languages/books/bibles. Until fluent-api can supply project-scoped or seedable master data ([fluent-api#373](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/373)), cold login cannot drop the full catalogue wait from Tier 1.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Login Tier 1 does not wait on the full world languages/books/bibles catalogue once an API path exists for the FK rows My Work needs
- [ ] Remaining master data syncs in Tier 2 / background without a Home full-screen block
- [ ] Unit tests cover the scoped master-data path

## Related

- Parent: #670
- API: fluent-api#373
